sn49.35-44:1.5: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya cattāro sammappadhānā bhāvetabbā.
sn49.35-44:1.8: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
sn49.35-44:1.9: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ime cattāro sammappadhānā bhāvetabbāti
sn49.35-44:1.10: …pe… bhāvetabbāti. (evaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāyāti ca
sn49.35-44:1.11: ekekasmiṃ soḷasa soḷasa katvā ekasatasaṭṭhi suttantā vitthāretabbā.)
